item.title: Close the Loop Before You Open Another
item.description: A youth program is ending while recurring sessions, payment ambiguity, a replacement offer, and a dense August calendar remain. It introduces a sunset line: close service, money, calendar, and family expectation before buying a substitute. Youth basketball guidelines and movement-behaviour research shift the denominator from one attractive session to the whole week, including travel, sleep, other sports, unstructured play, meals, and parental attention. The work shield treats a scheduling collision as a routing problem before a relationship problem, with firm exceptions for safety or formal duties. A WorkSafeBC owner map keeps an opportunity bounded. In the car, ask the boys to notice one beautiful movement that did not score, then listen without turning beauty into another lesson or family performance. Full transcript: https://arthurburtcurry.com/c7cQz082m963h-R6acs0vj5khhcWvUDK/episode-006-transcript.txt

item.title: Do Not Argue With the Night
item.description: An overnight medical call changes the social risk of the week. This briefing treats fatigue as a condition that can distort timing, scale, and interpretation, without excusing neglected duties. It builds a small protocol around feasible pre-call sleep extension, a fresh post-call driving decision, and a pause on optional conflict or motive analysis. A newly revised British Columbia coverage standard supplies the leverage idea: continuity should be engineered through clear roles, critical-result routing, patient instructions, and return handoffs, not permanent personal availability. The family move comes from Tom's own tutoring notes and a 2024 learning-by-teaching meta-analysis. Before SportsWeek, tell each boy he will teach one thing later. In the car, ask what happened just before he noticed it, then listen. Full transcript: https://arthurburtcurry.com/c7cQz082m963h-R6acs0vj5khhcWvUDK/episode-005-transcript.txt

item.title: Design the Way Back
item.description: A failed computer test becomes useful evidence before the new office makes physical recovery expensive. Tonight's briefing borrows recovery-time objectives from continuity planning and capacity lessons from queueing theory: optimize the return of critical functions, not the apparent perfection of every device or calendar hour. It closes one expiring youth-sport decision, builds a minimum viable fallback for paid work, and gives a clear stop rule for troubleshooting. A new 2026 meta-analysis sharpens the work shield: task, relationship, process, and status conflict all correlate negatively with team performance on average, so engagement should require a real decision delta or formal duty. The family move uses active-constructive responding with Tom's wife, plus a playful car question about a tiny emergency kit for disappointing days. Full transcript: https://arthurburtcurry.com/c7cQz082m963h-R6acs0vj5khhcWvUDK/episode-004-transcript.txt

item.title: Choose the Room That Comes Home

The episode addresses the security gate before relying on a workstation from the office, treats a signed file-review agreement as an option to measure before expanding, offers an employment-preserving boundary response, and uses one memory from yesterdayâ€™s lunch for relational savoring without adding another family task. item.title: Buy the Option, Not the Province
item.description: Several work possibilities have become real at once, but a faster licensing path is a reason to wait for demonstrated demand, not a reason to pre-buy another province. This episode builds a one-page expansion gate around actual file volume, total attention cost, regulator requirements, and fixed fees. It also catches two less obvious edges: incorporation can change WorkSafe Personal Coverage eligibility, and Geminiâ€™s privacy treatment differs between Workspace surfaces and personal Connected Apps. The work shield is a next-workday quarantine for non-urgent conflict drafts, with clear exceptions for safety and formal duties. The family move protects one unclaimed, phone-free transition in a Saturday already rich with sport, art, and a match. It favors quiet optionality over speculative administration and stimulation. Full transcript: https://arthurburtcurry.com/c7cQz082m963h-R6acs0vj5khhcWvUDK/episode-002-transcript.txt
